video.title: AI欧腐《以魂为契：黑暗复仇/Sold My Soul for Dark Revenge》
video.desc:
私信推荐的哈 翻译下
Fallen noble Cyril is tortured and robbed of his title by his uncle.To survive in despair,he signs a soul pact with a dark unicorn.He conceals his identity,accumulates wealth and plans revenge with his golden scent superpower and superb pharmaceutical skills.During his revenge,Cyril is forced into a substitute marriage with the reputedly cold and brutal Commander Lionell.He finds out the feared commander is the lover who rescued him many times before.The two unite to smash court plots and settle family feuds.They finally break the dark curse with the blood of unwavering true love and gain a new life.
落魄贵族 Cyril 遭叔父折磨，并被夺去爵位。为在绝境中求生，他与黑暗独角兽签下灵魂契约。此后他隐姓埋名，凭借"黄金气息"的异能与精湛的制药之术积累财富，暗中筹谋复仇。复仇途中，Cyril 被迫替嫁，嫁给了传闻中冷酷残暴的指挥官 Lionell，却发现这位令人闻风丧胆的指挥官，正是曾多次救他于危难的恋人。二人携手粉碎宫廷阴谋，了结家族恩怨，最终以坚贞不渝的真爱之血破除黑暗诅咒，重获新生。
